title: Homogenization of Time-Discrete Gradient Flows
summary: In this work, we study the homogenization limit for Fokker--Planck equations on the flat torus with rapidly oscillating diffusion coefficients at the time-discrete level. We discretize the equation in time using a minimizing movement scheme and compare two choices of metric: a transport-type metric and a weighted L2 metric. We prove that this choice is crucial: the two schemes lead to different homogenization limits as the scaling parameter tends to zero, and consequently to different evolution equations as the time step is sent to zero.
